headline: The line that doesn't last: Lemmings' one-shot blocker
lede: The original's block was never furniture — once a lemming climbs over his head, the blocker releases and walks. LEMMINGS-LITE now plays by that law, and THE SPIRE finally carries a blocker of its own at the pond.

notes.text: Climbers treat a blocker as the original's first rung: mount his head, land on the far side — dry ground if ground, the pond if that's what waits. Non-climbers still turn; corpses still pile.
Any body crossing the head line spends the block: the blocker resumes walking the direction he faced when he blocked — at a pond rim that walks him into the water, exactly like the 1991 game.

static caught SPIRE's new block:1 flipping the marquee's default skill to BLOCKER, collapsing the pointer replay — fixed by letting levels declare their tutorial arm (sim.defaultSkill, one source for game and harness). lemcheck 199/199 with three new wake pins and a red drift proof; lemplay 46/46 including a player-staged climb-over-the-line.
Lemmings is now held by the in-flight BUILDER skill work (#3863) — idle-kick correctly answers NONE; next free lane, look elsewhere until it lands.
